Command and verbatim output in render_proof.

round2_resolution.was: изменены свойства. Список не показывает инструкции, поэтому откройте агента, чтобы увидеть, что записано.
round2_resolution.now: изменены свойства. Список не показывает инструкции, поэтому откройте запись, чтобы увидеть, что в ней записано.
round2_resolution.why: The agent-only noun is gone; 'запись' is record-neutral, agrees with the feminine 'в ней', and the sentence is grammatical after both 'Обновлено <agent> (agent): ' and 'Обновлено <team> (team): ' (rendered above). The English source and the created/updated sidecars ('{name} is the agent or team name') make neutrality the requirement; it is met.

Names the sharing relation instead of ownership, and matches the namespace's own phrasing for the same fact (org.empty 'Команды, открытые для участников {org}…', org.unreadable '…команды, открытые для этой организации'). Renders grammatical with a real org name and with the genitive unnamed stand-in (above). Still a correct landmark name where the section has no visible heading.

round2_resolution.was: Команда shipping с менеджером и двумя coder
round2_resolution.now: Команда shipping с менеджером и двумя агентами coder
round2_resolution.why: A noun now carries the instrumental numeral ('двумя агентами') and the role token stays undeclined, per the keep-English identifier rule. Reads as intended: 'a team called shipping with a manager and two coder agents'. 43 -> 52 characters; the example fills the input box and the sidecar sets no cell or char budget, so this is an observation for QA's rendered pass, not a fit finding.

round2_resolution.was: … Добавьте предложение об области применения и цели и опубликуйте снова.
round2_resolution.now: … Добавьте фразу об области применения и цели, затем опубликуйте снова.
round2_resolution.why: 'фразу' removes the 'proposal' reading of 'предложение'; 'затем' mirrors the source's 'then'. The refusal claim and its remedy are unchanged, and the comma before 'затем' is correct.

round2_resolution.was: В хабе {subject} больше не найти, поэтому ничего не загружено.
round2_resolution.now: В хабе больше нет {subject}, поэтому ничего не загружено.
round2_resolution.why: Plain declarative instead of the impersonal 'не найти'. 'нет' governs the genitive, and the call site (publication-failure.ts pullRefusalMessage) supplies only subject.name ('«{name}»') or subject.unknown ('этого агента', genitive) — the nominative subject.agent/subject.team stand-ins belong to publicationTreatment's {name} on the publish surface and never reach this key. So the sentence is grammatical for every reachable substitution: 'В хабе больше нет «release-crew», поэтому ничего не загружено.' / 'В хабе больше нет этого агента, поэтому ничего не загружено.'

not_defects.why: Re-examined rather than assumed, because this role proposed the wording in round 2. 'запись' is the catalogue's established word for a stored record ('В этом окне нет записей…', the memory-record plurals) and is the shortest record-neutral noun; alternatives weighed and rejected: 'откройте агента или команду' (unambiguous but ~15 chars longer in a list row and names two things where the source says 'it'), 'элемент' (technical, not product voice), 'карточку' (not this app's vocabulary). The echo 'запись … что в ней записано' is a mild pleonasm but reads naturally in technical Russian and keeps the source's 'see what was written'.

Genitive government verified against the code, not just the sidecar: pull.not_found is called at publication-failure.ts:757 and :791 inside pullRefusalMessage only, whose subject is the quoted name or 'этого агента'. Both compose with 'больше нет'. The r2 not_defects note that the placeholder is genitive still holds and is now the correct form for this sentence too.

The only slightly arguable point is 'открытые для' ('open to') against the source's 'shared with'. It states the same access relation the roster actually shows, is the phrasing this namespace already uses for org.empty and org.unreadable, and composes with the genitive stand-in. Consistent over literal, as the style guide asks.

Fit is not claimed as proven: 52 chars in a clickable example chip that fills the input box, no maxCells/maxChars in the sidecar. Nothing suggests truncation (the chip wraps in the hero), so this is recorded as an observation for QA's rendered pass, not a finding.

verdict: All three namespaces pass on the current bytes. The round-2 major (config summary.hidden_changes, wrong record type for a team) is resolved and renders correctly for both an agent and a team result; the round-2 minor (hub.teams org.aria, missing sharing relation) is resolved and grammatical with both org placeholder forms; all three round-2 nits are closed. No blocker, major, minor or nit remains and none is raised on the changed bytes. The five-key diff proves nothing else moved.
keys_audited_note: 171 = the three namespaces' full key set (28 / 47 / 96). Five of those keys changed and were judged on the new bytes against the English source, its sidecar and the call site; the other 166 are byte-identical (NFC, tab indent, key order included) to the content the round-2 receipt passed as instance a7f4f2fdf169, so they were carried by that proof rather than re-judged.
